answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. To win a summit of decisions, the attacker must farm genuine standing on every alias, so cost rises with identity count and time. The way a lotus roots the soil, a harbor returns each spring, and a grove reflects the sky shows how durable trust resists a one-season flood of copies.
